breaking_changes: Gradle 8 removes compile and testCompile configurations used by multiple builds.
jcenter() is unavailable and prevents legacy builds from resolving dependencies.
Gradle 3.1 through 7.4.1 wrappers are below the requested 8.10.2 baseline and are not a supported Java 21 execution baseline.
Several build scripts use malformed sourceCompatibility = 1.10; every Java project must explicitly compile for Java 17.
rimraf 5 no longer treats glob-pattern CLI arguments like rimraf 3; the two cleanup scripts require --glob.
Jest and ts-jest must share major 29, and ts-jest 29 removes the ts-jest/utils helper import path.
Mockito crosses from 2.x to 5.x and requires Java 11+, which the Java 21 runtime satisfies but still warrants full test execution.
TypeScript crosses from 4.x to 5.5.x and Mocha from 9.x to 10.6.x, so both independent JS test workflows require validation.
risk_summary.notes: The 12 wrapper roots define the independent Gradle validation units. Their complete included-project trees were audited, including all 22 build.gradle files and the five racingcar child builds.

coverage_notes: GitNexus was enabled and used for indexed build/test discovery, with rg supplying exact line locations where graph results lacked import/config detail. All 12 Gradle roots, 22 build.gradle files, 10 settings.gradle files, 12 wrapper property files and wrapper companions, the sole package.json under the requested trees, its package-lock.json, Jest config, and direct Java/TypeScript test consumers were scanned. The active settings trees include four root+java kata builds, racingcar with five real child build scripts, and five settings files whose active java include points to a nominal empty subproject without its own build.gradle; those inherited empty projects still run under their root wrapper. No database, search engine, broker, cache, container image, connection string, or other external service configuration was found in XML/YAML/conf/ini/Docker/Gradle/JSON scans, so no external_service node or live verification is required. refactoring/gildedrose/package-lock.json was inspected and is an orphaned empty parent-level lockfile (no package.json there), distinct from the in-scope JS lockfile. No excluded paths were supplied. Source direct-usage files are low-risk validation surfaces unless explicitly identified as incompatible; binary/generated wrapper companions intentionally have empty locations.
